name: PBBANK
recent: Public Bank 获得批准以每股 HK$2.50 将香港子公司 PFHL 私有化并除牌。公司发布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日季度的业绩，营收环比下降 1.3%，净利环比下降 2.8%。同期 EPF 与 KWAP 多次申报作为大股东的持股变动。
notable: 获得批准以每股 HK$2.50 将香港上市子公司 PFHL 私有化并除牌。
发布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日季度的业绩。
risks: EPF 与 KWAP 在多个交易日申报大股东持股变动。
earnings: 2026 年第三季度营收为 MYR 3,773.79 百万，环比下降 1.3%，同比增长 1.3%；净利为 MYR 1,773.13 百万，环比下降 2.8%，同比下降 3.8%；净利率为 47.0%，上一季度为 47.7%。

recent_en: Public Bank received approval to privatise and delist its Hong Kong subsidiary PFHL at HK$2.50 per share. The company released quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026, with revenue down 1.3% QoQ and net income down 2.8% QoQ. EPF and KWAP filed multiple substantial shareholder changes during the period.
notable_en: Received approval to privatise and delist Hong Kong-listed subsidiary PFHL at HK$2.50 per share.
Released quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026.
risks_en: EPF and KWAP filed substantial shareholder changes on multiple trading days.
earnings_en: 3Q2026 revenue was MYR 3,773.79 million, down 1.3% QoQ and up 1.3% YoY; net income was MYR 1,773.13 million, down 2.8% QoQ and down 3.8% YoY; net margin was 47.0% versus 47.7% in the prior quarter.
